sources.title: GitHub - kyutai-labs/pocket-tts: A TTS that fits in your CPU (and pocket)
sources.snippet: A lightweight text-to-speech (TTS) application designed to run efficiently on CPUs. Forget about the hassle of using GPUs and web APIs serving TTS models. With Kyutai's Pocket TTS, generating audio is just a pip install and a function call away.
